patthana16.79:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.79:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho na na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika dassanenapahātabbahetukaduke nasanidassanattika nadassanenapahātabbahetukadukaṃ
